title: MSCI Rules Today on Cutting Strategy (MSTR) From Its Indexes After a Draft List Marks It Deleted
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

MSCI Rules Today on Cutting Strategy (MSTR) From Its Indexes After a Draft List Marks It Deleted

MSCI publishes its November index review at 5 p.m. ET, the first under a new non-operating company screen. Its potential list, built on Sept. 30 filings, already marks Strategy, Metaplanet and three others as Deleted.

This post MSCI Rules Today on Cutting Strategy (MSTR) From Its Indexes After a Draft List Marks It Deleted first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Russia’s Central Bank Clears Exchange to Open Bitcoin and Crypto Trading on Nov. 22
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Russia’s Central Bank Clears Exchange to Open Bitcoin and Crypto Trading on Nov. 22

A Bank of Russia ordinance published Wednesday lets exchanges start organized crypto trading on Nov. 22, but only after the central bank approves their rules. Moscow Exchange still aims for Dec. 1.

This post Russia’s Central Bank Clears Exchange to Open Bitcoin and Crypto Trading on Nov. 22 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

Deutsche Bank Switches On Bitcoin Custody for Paying Clients

Germany's largest lender now holds bitcoin, ether and three stablecoins for institutional and corporate clients in Europe, but it has not named any customers or disclosed fees.

title: LNbits Releases 1.7.0 Urgent Security Update After November 8 Attacks Drain Funds
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

LNbits Releases 1.7.0 Urgent Security Update After November 8 Attacks Drain Funds

LNbits released version 1.7.0 on November 10 as an urgent security update following active attacks that began November 8. Operators must upgrade before restarting servers as prior versions put funds at risk of theft.

This post LNbits Releases 1.7.0 Urgent Security Update After November 8 Attacks Drain Funds first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Juan Galt.
